patch_description: Builds on the best-performing prior architecture (adaptive Kalman + RTS smoother + volatility-blended multi-scale zero-phase SG + soft sigmoid-gated trend lead) and adds the recommended targeted fix: instead of another unconditional smoothing pass, it applies a short zero-phase SG polish (half-width max(2, sg_half//3)) only in quiet regions where |smoothed slope| < 0.25*q_scale, blended with np.where. This attacks residual dither (slope changes / false reversals) where it lives — flat regions — without adding trend distortion or lag in genuine transitions. All stages include explicit length/finite guards (Gen 90's failure mode).
